title: plugin-view: ObjectView generateViewSchema drops the board settings summary, showFieldLabels and hideEmptyFields
body:
repo:objectstack#7 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jTeURPvEm465RcoYEC

Follow-up from #36370 (PR #36411, kanban gets its own view settings). L1 found the gap and the PR records it with no carrier. Filed by the seat. Parent: #36370.

## What happens

`ObjectView#generateViewSchema` in the plugin-view package builds the board schema without passing the three new board keys through: `summary`, `showFieldLabels` and `hideEmptyFields`. A board drawn through that path ignores the settings an author saved. The Console path that #36411 fixes passes them.

## To do

1. Pass the three keys through `generateViewSchema`, the same way the Console path does.
2. Pin it with a test that renders a board through this path with each key set and unset.

## Acceptance

- A board drawn through plugin-view honours `summary`, `showFieldLabels` and `hideEmptyFields` exactly as the Console board does.

Blocked-by: #36411

## Grade
p2 · area:ux · domain:ui. A saved setting is ignored on one render path.
